Drink customization is garbage now. They removed most of my favorite frappuccinos in '25 and nowadays the app won't let you make something as simple as a Strawberry and Matcha frappuccino. Horrible layout. No easy way to order or track redeemable points. You keep clicking "collect" on offers and nothing gets selected. Useless. The app has always been on the slower side but worked for loading, ordering, and paying. The last time I tried to use it about a year or so ago and it wouldn't let me load funds. Had the app for years and didn't have any problems. Since May this year I've been unable to see the correct amount of funds on my card. App has been advertising the pairings menu for days. I've tried every way I can think of to access it and nothing works. I am so disappointed in this app and how it's the ONLY way to get points! Only giving it 1 star to get the developers' attention. Things that are lacking: 1. App is okay. Convenient for finding locations when away from home. Beware the birthday drink though. This is the biggest waste of time and probably a ripoff. It will not let me put in my personal information, insisting "system error" every time I try to save it. The app works pretty flawlessly for the most part. So what's available for one isn't always for another. But if you tell the barista they can ring it up on their end so why not on the app? Overall not too bad of an app though.

It was working well for a month or so, but doesn't let you know which stores participate in which promotion. Today, it stopped working completely. I cannot add funds to my Starbucks card, use it to pay, or see Starbucks locations nearby. Made me lose out on both the stars from my order and the promotional stars I was supposed to get. If your App stops working randomly, maybe don't have time limited promotions/challenges and waste customers' time and money.

The app resets often then locks me out. This has happened several times. Even after trying to reset the password, I still can't log back into my account. I have gone through customer service and after after multiple attempts they fixed it but once again the same problem is happening. This has happened to my friend's as well, so I'm guessing their app has issues. Very frustrating especially if I have money in my account that I can't access.

For the last few weeks, we are no longer able to see our previous orders. We can find them online, but they no longer appear on the app. The previous orders were extremely helpful as we could simply reorder a customized beverage. We noticed, in other reviews, that we are not the only one experiencing this issue. Hopefully, Starbucks will update their app so that the previous orders appear again.

Update 07/21/2025 Still cannot install app or order from app. "System error". Attempted to install more than 5 times. "Sorry we're experiencing an error" for several weeks. Also empties cart when you switch to another app (for example, transferring money to pay or asking a friend what they want via text). I had to put the same items in my cart more than 3 times and then went to Funkin' Donuts. Poor quality app. I do not shop at SBux anymore due to app, no rewards, bathroom policy.

Just okay. Menu is complicated, & there's no search. Learning all the tricks of the app is key. Starbucks employees can't help, unless you get a tech-savy mgr. I wish I could pay for extra shots with stars on the app. But it's all stars or all $. And there's no place to indicate you are asking for the cup-refill discount. Location section is good, but it's confusing to see whether or not my order is placed once I choose a location.

Great until this morning- I kept getting an error when looking for order ahead locations saying that there weren't any. The scanning section wasn't working when I tried to pay for my order. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app and now I'm not even able to sign back in! It just says that there was a system error and to try again later.

Very handy and love it for mobile order, but there are some things to work out. For instance, the bonus star opportunities never count all my purchases. Even simple challenges like "order 3 days in a row" never works. Usually every other order only counts, so I'm lucky if I earn the bonus stars at all. Even the new Starbucks bingo didn't count one of the requirements I made the other day. Other than that, very convenient for in store and mobile orders.

Each update is getting worse and worse. I at least was able to use the app prior to whatever just happened. Simply terrible! Trying to add money to your account through the app has became impossible. It kicks it back so you have to add money in store. Also,If you logged out of your account anytime since the previous few updates, your locked out now and elevating the issue has provided no relief.

The app is fine, but compared to other food apps, there are like no coupons. There's a buy 1 get 1 free drink on Fridays, but it's strictly only 12-6 PM. Other than that, there's no other coupons. Edit: looks like Starbucks has chosen to not provide any coupons at all. The app is otherwise useless unless you only use it to order in advance, since the star point system is practically worthless. I'm not made of money, they'd likely get more service if I had a coupon to use every once and a while.

The biometric function when adding funds to my Starbucks card hasnt worked for the last two weeks. I reset my password and the biometric still doesn't work. I receive and error that says "We were unable to complete your request. Please try again later." Then it doesn't even give me the auto fill password option. Highly annoying.

This app is useless unless you live in a metro area. Why? No curbside pickup and no ordering ahead. Go wait in line with the other 30 cars or wait inside in a small, poorly ventilated shop. Order tab eventually loads, I think. Took WAY too long on house Wi-Fi so I uninstalled within a minute. All these stores near me and not one offer two of the three features. Sad. The ones about a half hour do. Oh joy! I can "skip" the lines but I have to waste 30 minutes for some coffee.

At first was good. You can load gift cards, order ahead, pay in store & set up other payment methods, all the while keeping track of favorite and previous order, and star points. However, the map shows locations inside stores that a) don't accept gift cards because they "proudly represent Starbucks" and b) don't take mobile orders. If they don't take mobile orders, they shouldn't be listed as an option on the app or website. Additionally, baristas don't always see all the customizations ordered.

Was great, but after this update, the app takes 10x longer to load and when loading the scan page, it also takes longer than before. For example I would open the app to pay after I ordered in the drive thru. Now I started the app a half mile away and still barely got it loaded by the time I placed my order. No improvements, just the addition of longer wait times.

The is app is easy to use. A $5 reload option would be great. Sometimes I am only a few cents off and need to add money. I realize my other cards might have money but the gold card I prefer. The app needs a way to stay updated. Items are available when not or state they are not available when on hand. Same with drink items. A system needs to be put in place. I have called numerous times about something and been told we have it, when the site says different and vice versa.

This is just a general complain about the reward system, no technical aspects. The idea of only being able to keep your stars if you have gold is stupid. Any other app such as McDonald's let's you redeem an item and then keep the remaining stars left over. I've had my stars erased after accumulating 200 points and reedeming an item, three different times. I understand that it drives people to purchase more, however no one has time to buy starbucks everyday, esp broke college students.

I've had the app for a long time. Over the past few weeks, I have no longer been able to order in the app. I tried talking with support, and eventually after back and forth and trying everything they suggested, was told that this is a known issue that when you go to order once clicking on your location, the app crashes. I can use the app on a laptop or desktop, but that's very inconvenient. It also stopped accepting my password and I had to change it. hopefully this issue will be fixed soon.

Just tried signing up through the app and nope, continue to receive a "system error" message. After reading some other reviews, this seems to be an ongoing issue with others not being able to sign up either, and absolutely no response from the developer! Let's just say the app has since been uninstalled and in less than 10 minutes after installing it...

This app is user friendly and easy to pay with. I don't use the app to follow promos or to pay ahead. Even after refreshing my app, I never get an accurate number of stars or my updated card balance until about 3-4 days later. Also, I always have to update my password to add more money, because it always tells me my password is incorrect. Luckily, I haven't held up a line yet, so I'm not too bothered by the inconvenience, but I can imagine I'm not the only person with this problem.

Can no longer use the app. It always says system error, try again later. I removed the app and went to google play and reloaded it several times. I changed my password several times also. Very frustrating! As big of a company as you are why can't you fix this problem? Also I called contact number and asked to speak with technical support. I was told to expect an email in 24 to 48 hours. That was days ago!

10/18/20 App doesn't allow me to log back in after the update. I can log in from computer and even login from the phone browser but not the App. Annoying and disappointing The order section is not organized well. Brewed coffee is way down the long list of menu. I can't find the section that showed all the past transactions easily in the menu page. In addition, it would be great if we can transfer any amount between cards and not entire balance at once.

The app is helpful when you're out and want to order something from the nearest Starbucks. The app also lets you tip the barista, but not comment on the quality of service or purchase. Also you can win Bonus Stars through purchases that lead to free drinks or other items. When it works it's great. However, there are times when I've purchased the required drink for Bonus Stars and the app does not reflect this. I did not receive credit

Caution - the Starbucks app does not reflect the store's stock. If you order and pay for an item that is not in stock, the store is not able to process a refund. Using online forms does not seem to work either. Calling their customer service line did result in a refund plus additional credit, but unless one is willing to go through that aggravation and hassle, it is better to just order in person and wait.

I have been a loyal patron of Starbucks for years now. For the last month the app won't open, will freeze, the barcode payment will not pull up. Needless to say it's been really frustrating and I can't pay through the app to get my rewards. I have uninstalled and installed the app a couple of times and the issues still keep happening. It's so frustrating that I just don't even want to get my morning coffee and pastry anymore and go elsewhere.

The app is fine. Works well. But Starbucks continues to rip people off. I have registered for their promotions, I have followed directions, and several times they have not taken a transaction into account to fulfill the promotion. Or when it's double points, I pay with a gift card and I only get the double points for either using the gift card or the actual promotion, either way...I read I'm so supposed to get 4x the points. I am disappointed.

Downloaded the app to sign up for the rewards program and add a few my purchases from that week, I kept getting "sorry we're experiencing a system error try again later" a few times, so I went to the desktop site and joined. Thinking that resolved the issue or I'd at least be able to log in, NOPE! So since zero stars isn't an option, here's the 1, I guess for the app at least being download-able! Go figure.

Very convenient and easy to use...except that some orders aren't fully customizable because they won't have options available (that you'd find if you used your internet browser). Ex: app won't let me add a seasonal/special syrup to customize my order; however, if not using the app, you could easily customize your order via web browser. Otherwise, simple to use and order.

Very simply, the app will not permit me to sign up. I've tried using alternate email address, different password, etc. All fields completed correctly but when I hit "Submit", it says "An error has occurred, please try again later." I have tried to join at several different physical locations but get the same error message every time. Extremely disappointing.

App works as described. But over the last 2 years I have had so much trouble with the app and signing in. Once I'm signed in it's okay, but the app logs you out everytime it updates. and when I go to login it tells me my password is incorrect, EVERY TIME. I've had to go in and change my password, which I then save for easier login, and even have copied and pasted into a protected document. but when I go to login, no matter the method, it will tell me password incorrect.

I love the app however some improvements could be made to make it even more customizable! adding the ability to order half pumps would be great! also, egg nog is not an option to order as an "add in" during winter months. the app often says it is "sold out "of items when the store actually has them in stock. store members have told me they are not able to update their stock on the app, which could be a nice option for them. thanks!

Does what it's designed to do, and does it pretty well. Estimates for ordering ahead are way off, often says it'll take 15-20 mins, but is ready in 5. Doesn't reliably notify when order is complete, often very late to receive the notification, sometime half an hour after actually picking it up. These are minor gripes though, and the ability to earn points when using my company card during business travel trumps all other issues.

The app was glitchy, but it has sorted itself out. Starbucks needs to update the app items better. I can't tell you how many times I have ordered something through the app, including today and when I arrive at the Starbucks, they are missing some or all of the ingredients to make that drink (or missing an item all together). Also, lately I can be the only pick order and still have to wait after even new customers come in. I waited 25 minutes today. I could go on but this limits my word count.

Update I still like the app but there are still some major flaws in it. First, the find a store function still does not work. I travel a lot and I count on the app to select a store close to me. If I knew where it was I would not need to find a store. Second, you ordering function would be more effective if it was tied to the find a store. It's hard to order ahead if you don't know where the store is and it is less than useless if I'm in Washington DC and it ask me to allow the app to know my location then it defaults to a store in TN. This needs to be fixed. Great app to use instead of a card that is somewhere in your wallet. They send you special through the app but they dont tell you the discount or the price. If you want me to try something different from my regular order then tell me how much cheeper it will be to try it now or tell me it's only $1.99. Update. Still like the app but you cant count on the map always; google is faster. When I travel it's nice to have my coffee ready because hotel coffee is really bad most of the time.

Under normal circumstances I would love to give the app a 5 star review due to the ease of use. However, I'm quite unhappy with removal of the widget. I primarily used the widget when it was available. Yes, I've read that we can make it into a shortcut, but I basically had that option to begin with and I never wanted it. That opinion still holds true.

I enjoy starbucks, and just like many, app worked fine until a few weeks ago. I have not been able to log in, and have the "system error, try again" everytime I try to log in. I was excited when it looked like an update came out on July 2 (v6.9), but still receiving the same message. Very disappointing that Starbucks doesn't seem motivated to fix this bug.

It basically works but unlike being inside a starbucks with a complete menu, there are no prices listed. Every item is "add to cart to see your price" which is extremely frustrating for those who are watching a budget. I add then delete, then try another item then delete. This app is clearly targeted only to those who dont have to work in a budget. I'll just use up my gift card and delete the app and account.

On the android app, the purchase history use to be next to Inbox but now it's hidden under Account. This makes it very hard to find to be able to leave a tip. It makes no sense, change it back or at least update your screenshots in Google Play to accurately reflect where you can locate the damn history. I'm sure a lot of barista's aren't receiving the tips they use to....BECAUSE NO ONE CAN FIND IT! Please fix!!!

Ridiculous. "Forgot password", "we'll send you an email" - no email. "Forgot username", "we'll send you an email" - no email. Finally the app is logged into, before I can use it, it asks to send me notifications. Twice. Find my store, order ahead.. Nope, you can't order ahead. What's the point?! (For the travelers jug, you have to order 30 minutes in advance, guess I'm simply supposed to go there in person twice). As I said, ridiculous.

The online ordering is so annoying with this app and their website. For one thing, if you add things to your cart and then don't check out right away, it's all gone if you come back to it 10 minutes later. Second it's stupid they make you "reload" instead of just letting you pay with a card like every other online ordering. Keeps giving me errors while trying to do that after it makes me login again, which loses my cart again. Pointless app and website.

"Favorited" locations should show up first & should always be visible & quick & easy to access, whether you have GPS on or not. I spend half my time trying to spell locations correctly JUST so I can finally see my favorites list, I made them favorites for a reason. Heck, they should be the first option before even getting to a map, or have a button that gets you to favorite locations instantly.

It easy to use. However, it is deceptive when going in for an advertisement. I would like to have offers of the day automatically apply. I ordered a few times before I realized that I had to ask everytime. I thought paying with the app would be pretty straightforward, but it isn't, unless you start the order from the app. Is it set up this way in hopes that the customer forgets to ask? I may forget to get the free thing, but I won't forget the lack of fulfilling the offer to bring me in.

I've been using this app for YEARS and it really does keep getting bettering. The only thing I wish for at this point is for them to allow cup adjustment. I often get a tall frappuccino's with 3 added shots and extra ice. All that obviously doesn't fit in a tall cup. But the batista will still "try" to make it fit; and always ends up pouring half my drink down the drain. That includes the extra $2 I paid for those extra shots!! Nothing now makes me more frustrated!

Availability isn't always right--frequently arrive at the store only to be given a refund. Timing is often wrong, which can be troublesome when I'm picking up a coffee on my way into work. But the convenience of ordering ahead and walking in, picking up, and walking right back out is awesome when everything works as it should.

UPDATE- constant updates and lack of space on my phone make this app too big.81.49 MG BEFORE THE UPDATE!I wish we still had the option of using the app without the mandatory update! Tired of constant updates eating my storage. You should have an alternate app with just the basics . I don't care about browsing for gifts, I don't care about music I just want to be able to order my coffee and that's it! We all don't have large amounts of storage and fast data. How about a "Lite" version of the app?

This app would be great if it always registered your purchases-specifically for the menu challenges. MANY times I participate in these weekly challenges to earn more stars, but the app doesn't acknowledge my purchase and I am then inconvenienced by having to email Starbucks as to the error, which can take several days to get resolved. By that time, I have already forgotten about it. Very frustrating, especially since they don't provide a phone number to call and get the issue resolved sooner.

The app hardly ever works. I'm not sure if it's just the app or a bigger issue since I also get the same error on their site. I shouldn't have to look up a multi step tutorial to get a coffee shop app to work. Idk when I'll be able to access my account again and it's frustrating when all I want to do is order ahead so there's less issue for the drive thru workers.

I am very disappointed that the Widget has been removed. I used it tell at a glance if I could afford a coffee-run and how far to go for a star reward. The shortcut option is stupid. I hate extra icons on my screen and that is all the shortcut is, an icon. I visit Starbucks regularly, but only because I can use the app to make the purchase quickly so I can rush back to work. If you keep messing with the app, I'm afraid I will have to find another option for my caffiene runs.

I like that you can tip through the app! I DO NOT like that I can't customize my coffee creamer other than clicking "splash" of cream. I want to be able to put the number of creamers I want because a "splash" from one person to the next is not the same! So sometimes my coffee is too strong and sometimes too milky. This could be avoided by being able to be specific with how many creamers I want added. It doesn't even let you say , "light splash" or "extra splash."

App is user-friendly. The birthday coupon for one free item made the most expensive item on my order free when I was expecting the least expensive item to be free, so that was a pleasant surprise. Thank you. One minor complaint, which is not big enough to lose a star: There is no custom tip option. I wanted to tip $3, but the only options were no tip, $0.50, $1, $2, $5.

Love the app most of the time, great freebies and rewards! However, on occasion, I order something and when I get there, it isn't available and I need to get a refund. Other times I know something is available and the app won't let me order it, saying it's not. [Edit: 12.19.18] I love the app, but lately, I've been "shorted" three rewards. It seems to happen when I have 7-8 rewards in que. It's frustrating to buy and play the games/challenges, and then not get the reward. It's problematic.

MODIFIED: Bonus Rewards just keep getting worse!! Less and less rewards for more and more purchases!! SMH. BECOMING NOT WORTH IT TO BUY ANYTHING HERE! App works great now. Had some issues when I first used it about a year ago. It seems that has been fixed and now I use the app ALL THE TIME. Mobile ordering avoids any long waits, in and out! It's awesome.....

Cannot log into the app or even on the web. Gives an error message that states error can not log in to try again, but it doesn't matter how many times I try it doesn't work. I've restarted the app, my phone, un-installed the app, and nothing. I have money on my account and have points and can not access anyway. I have been having this issue for days now.

I have recently completed offers and they do not 'count' for stars...it's highly disappointing and seems like contesting it is useless. The latest was for purchasing 4 different items (which I did) using the app; I should have received 175 stars. Instead I received nothing AND the offer isn't even showing in past offers to argue it. Seems like a bait and switch. In the future, I probably won't participate.

Automatically switches my store without telling me so I end up sending orders across town. It also doesn't notify you when a dining room is closed so I'll show up to find only the drive thru is open with a line wrapped around the building that I don't have the time to wait in. I've wasted so much money on this app because of not being able to pick up my order.

This app conveniently fails to work when I am at Starbucks. Gift cards won't open and it keeps crashing, especially when I try to add rewards (they expire now, too!). The format is ok, which is why I gave it 2 stars, plus the ads and marketing material seem to work seamlessly. I wish the app would remember my password so I don't have to keep remembering it.

This app sucks. If I could give it less than 1 star I would. It constantly crashes and/or locks me out of my account. I lost my gold card and have not been able to get a replacement (despite reporting it lost on the site). This app is the only way I can earn rewards for my purchases but it never works when I try to use it. Don't bother downloading. Waste of time.

New issue...how come oat milk is offered but not available to choose on the app??? I've asked store employees and they all have oat milk, but you cannot order it from the app. It's impossible to use. Shuts down. Error messages over and over and over. Doesn't refresh amount on card...rewards. Tried uninstalling and still can't recognize my user name. Hard to get the points you barely earn anyhow. This has all been since the last update a week or so ago. Please fix the bugs!!!

Used to love this app. Was so awesome to be able to order my coffee from my phone and swing by the store and pick it up. BUT NOT ANY MORE!!! That's a thing of the past!! 1. The app can't find any Starbucks stores... anywhere. 2. I can't reload my Giftcards. 3. Constantly getting error messages of no internet connection (that's bad) or that the app is experiencing an error. 4. Its slow as hell. 4 minutes to load the home page??! Really?!?!

App runs well on HTC U12. A suggestion for next update might be to add a rating or feedback option for your order. I've come to notice the drinks prepared at my local store are inconsistent, and nowadays they always make bland drinks. As I always do pickup order from the app, I find out the drink is bad when I step out of the store. Sometimes you just don't have time to ask them to remake it. Maybe there could be a way in the app to remind them to do a better job next time.

It's nice to be able to order ahead and have your drink ready when you get there; however, the purchasing system is very manipulative. There is no option for paying for individual purchases, you must buy at least a $25 digital gift card, and keep it funded (at least $25 per refill) if you want to order anything through the app. This is a super shady way to strong arm customer loyalty

Can't imagine not having this app! I'll never wait for coffee again. It finds nearby Starbucks and lets me order ahead. It always accurately notifies me when it's ready. I even order by app when I'm in a store if there's a line. In big cities it can be hard to know the location name but I still get my order faster by app after arriving than if I waited in line of more than 2 or 3! And it's so easy to order because it remembers my favorites.

App is useless to me. No matter where I am, the app says pre ordering is not available at that location. When I look up locations, it says no location accept pre orders within a 10 mile radius! Seriously? I even asked in store and they said they absolutely accept pre orders. Cleared cache and data, uninstalled and reinstalled. Still not working. Get better developers, Starbucks. You can afford it.

Sometimes it allows you to order even when the store doesn't have all the ingredients to make your drink and they don't inform you until you've waited for the drink. I just wish the store and app had a push notification where the baristas could input order unfulfilled due to missing ingredients or something. and of course automatically refund you for whatever item that can't be fulfilled.

I think it could be faster but what I don't like the most is being logged out and having to log in again when you are right at the cashier paying... Also, once you log in again it puts you back to a Green level! It is very confusion because some offers are for Green level users and others are for Gold...I am not sure if there is something wrong with my account! Besdies that, it is great to be able to register your Starbucks card and reload it with auto-load!

It would be very much helpful if add a visit was available to add a transaction when you don't have time to scan for your points. I was highly disappointed it wasn't an option available to use. Now I have the app, tried to update my profile, birthday, and address... it won't even allow me to enter my country as USA. This nerve-wracking guess I'll stop going spending so much 4-5 times a week. I also purchase items for my employees for months now. Please fix the features mentioned in your app.

Very convenient, but the point expires too quickly, and the coupon/offers always expire before it says it will, which sucks. I received a notice to receive a drink for $3 good for 1/28-1/29, but on 1/29, it's no longer available. It would be a good idea not to include the date that you will remove the offers if not used. I've several offers & so many points due to this issue.

This app makes ordering coffee extremely easy, plus you can completely cut the line inside. You just walk in and pick up your goods without standing in line. It's also nice because you can customize your drinks just the way you like it! Adding money is just as easy too, just connect a card and choose how much to reload and that's it. Great app. Even if you don't drink Starbucks that often, give this a shot or two!

This app used to be so useful and helpful for those of us with busy schedules that don't allow for the constant 20-25 minute counter waits inside of most Starbucks locations. However, I've noticed the past month or so, it has been freezing frequently and closing itself out for no apparent reason. Now, the app is suddenly refusing to open/load past the initial logo screen. Absolutely infuriating. I love your products, but you need to fix these issues. Lord knows Starbucks has the money for it.

The app could be good if it worked properly. My app continuously billed me $25 with each single coffee purchase of $6, after I selected the auto recharge option. Menu functionality is not used friendly. Difficult to navigate and reorder of previous purchases. I order the same coffee everyday. This should have an option to select a favorite menu item and add it to the cart. Too many ads on front page instead of just letting me order my daily coffee and get to work.

Overall good app but it is so stupid that you can't use multiple payments. I can't finish using small balances on gift cards because if your balance is too low to cover your order, it forces you to reload the gift card with a $10 minimum in order to use it. You can't make up the remaining order charge with a credit card for example. Need to fix this.

The app stopped allowing me to sign in a few months ago, I could only get a "sorry could not sign you in" message using the same password that worked on the website. Starbucks Customer Care had multiple levels that repeatedly asked me to do the same things (reinstall, clear cache, etc.) that did nothing to help . I eventually removed the app, there are plenty of places to get coffee. ***Review edited to add comments about lack of assistance from customer care.

Easier than carrying and reloading plastic. Tracks rewards. Shows you the nearest shop when travelling. Allows you to combine/transfer multiple gift card balances into one on your Gold card instead of dragging around extra plastic. Occasionally glitches but what doesn't... Customer support responded and resolved an issue I had with not recieving stars within 24hrs. Kudos.

This app SUCKS. I've been trying to use it for MONTHS. Every time I try to do anything, it tells me "something went wrong on our end!" But every time!?!?!? It won't let me add a gift card until I add an address. It won't let me add an address because "something is wrong". I deleted the app and tried to download again to see if it was different, but no.

The purpose of downloading this app was to sync my card and complete mobile ordering(to eliminate waiting 20 minutes at drive thru). A majority of products are listed as sold out daily, even though they are in-stock and can be ordered at the drive thru. I contacted management and was informed it was a glitch in the app and they are receiving orders regularly for the products Im requesting by other mobile users. Extremely annoying 😒

It's a major disappointment to have lost the widget. It was much quicker and more efficient. I could see my balance at a glance, and start orders on the go. Now, if I try to long press the app button, or open the app, I have to wait several moments before anything comes up, which, if you're standing in line at the store is pretty inconvenient. The new rewards system is much more complicated and less intuitive. What made the rewards system so good was that it was clear and easy. Not so much now.

The most recent update killed the app. I can't log back in and continue to get system error messages that the troubleshooting steps don't fix. The major perk of the app was being able to mobile order and since I can't even log in, there is really zero purpose for the app. Hopefully it is updated soon! Especially since it's the time of year for gift cards.

Nearly impossible to select the right location. I could be directly in front of one store, and the "nearby" locator will default to a location on the other side of town. Most towns have multiple stores, many on the same main road and sometimes in the same complex. You can't cancel either, so the options are to go far out of your way for coffee or just eat the cost, all because they refuse to have the app show the actual nearest location.

No offers, no point. I heard you could get 50% off on tuesdays in July. I downloaded the app only to see there are no offers. The only point seems to be a free drink for every $150 spent, but I'd rather just never spend that much money at Starbucks. The best way this app can save you money is by showing you how bad the deals are. I'm uninstalling. Their privacy policy and data collection seems like a bit much too.

I don't know what happened, but the app gives an error message when I try to order ahead. I get the pecan crunch latte, and the app says no stores in my area sell it. I was getting one a week until 2 weeks ago when the app stopped letting me. I also noticed that I have been double charged, like the app automatically doubled up on my items. App is great, but stores should have the option to let people know if they can't come inside to pick their order up before they get to the door to find out they have to go througin the drive thru to pick their order up. App hasn't worked in a year and a half. It gets frozen on the logo screen that shows up when you start the app. Never goes beyong that point. Great! but wish I was still allowed to get the mail options for atleast my rewards and birthday, since I can keep track. I really love this app! I used to keep cash for tips in my car and sometimes forget and feel so bad, the app allows you to tip! You need to add an app feedback within your app. The drink menu should update to show the promotion, so the user doesn't have to search for drinks that match your promotion. it will have offers then they don't follow through. example order during this time, get a free drink some within 24 hours. then nothing. happened a few times. then i just got a request for an order i didn't place, my balance was reduced and no way to respond. it was some store that i have no idea where it is.

Very convenient. Lots of limited customization options when ordering. I would like the ability to cancel an order within a few minutes, for example if you accidentally order trom the wrong store. Most of my past complaints about the app have been addressed. Unfortunately, it does not work when traveling in Canada.

Missing stars! They need a way to scan recipts in the app for when they are having problems at the store and can't scan! This has happened way to many times. Also it would be nice to just be able to pull up the menu without picking a store to order from.

The app is easy to navigate and understand, and the reload & combine gift card balance options are quick and simple. The only gripe I have isn't with the app so much as the company: they recently revamped their rewards system and took away all of the previously earned stars. The app has been very good, funtionality has been fantastic. This morning I tried to update. The update failed, so I cleared cache, and tried to update. Too many of the stores are consistently disorganized and the time it takes to prepare the order is often more than double what is displayed. This app is sweet! Make your selection(s) with a couple taps (saved in Favorites!), a couple more to pick a store (if you're not at your local shop), a couple more pays the tab & racks up points! All that's left is the fly-by to grab-n-go & you're golden! Thanks for making it so easy.

I really love and enjoy this app, my only suggestion would be to allow us to reload any amount to our virtual gift cards instead of having a minimum of 10 dollars. For years it has been a good app but lately I get a login error and it makes me login again. It normally is logged on always once logged in. It makes it very inconvenient to have to log in again.

Awesome app and extremely helpful that you can load card via app and it becomes available immediately. There are sometimes however, that it doesn't count my visit to Starbucks when there's a challenge going on and the visits count...That's my only negative I've experienced!

Instead, they happily charged me for a Venti but delivered my drink in a single Tall cup. Starbucks says that drink splitting is not allowed/possible; but, they do not warn us on the mobile order form that this is the case. I've asked them "Why would I order and pay for a Venti (20 oz drink) and only get a Tall (12 oz drink) amount of it? It makes no sense!". The least the store could've done was deliver a Venti (as shown on the order label) and offer an empty cup to split it myself; but, the store delivered a single Tall. The Store was nice enough to give me the second Tall at no extra charge; but, I had to complain about it to get it. They, and the corporate chat service, also essentially said "Don't do that again".
App keeps telling me I need to update it as a UK customer. I live in the US. I have uninstalled and reinstalled the app multiple times. Tried to login and reset password etc, nothing works.

App is broken and you cannot contact them to fix their junk. I have to add funds to the card/app and then their irresponsible behavior prevents my access to my own funds. For the last two weeks I keep getting a system error in the app. I have done everything I possibly can to try to fix it. The "improvements" to the rewards program are garbage. If challenges were also removed, I'll be uninstalling for sure. I'm not going out of my way to spend $75 for a free $4 coffee. It would be great if it worked. It freezes all the time. I even re installed it and it still wouldn't work. Super frustrating and has caused me to not spend money at Starbucks. The line is always super long and the app won't work. It sucks.

This was my experience trying to create an account: Enter in all information...asks me to enter password, even though I have entered password. Restart app, try again. Same issue. So far so good. I appreciate being able to pay through the app and simply pick up my order. The app won't let me sign in, and I'm not sure whether or not if it's my phone, but even if I try to sign in at my house, it still won't work. Other than that (before the app wouldn't let me sign in), the app was great and worked fine. Hopefully they can fix this soon.

Used to be a great app, now glitchy, unable to reload, frequently the only drink I get, a COFFEE is not available for remote ordering. A COFFEE!!!!! Starbucks overall service is pathetic, what they created, is gone. I have frequented Starbucks weekly for 25 yrs... Sad to see such a decline.

Used to work great, but now it crashes when I try to add more funds to my card, so it's currently a useless app. Until I can add funds and pay with the app again, I'm completely dissatisfied. Fix that and I'd probably send a glowing review.

I have a Samsung S8+. Every other app on my phone works perfectly except this one. It worked only a couple of times and now it just hangs up in the opening green screen and freezes. I tried removing and reinstalling and it's still doing the same thing. I'm over it.

easy great app. I use it all the time

This app was wonderful until last week. You updated the how the rewards work and now I can't load money!! It's super frustrating. It made my Starbucks runs so much faster. Now I would rather go somewhere else for coffee. Please fix it or I'm going back to Dunkin Donuts.

I have 2 complaints the 1st one is the times you limit when you make your dark coffee, you feel a pour over is good enough, that's coffee wash, your not brewing the coffee you're just letting the water run through the grinds really fast and anyone who drink as much dark coffee as I do can taste difference. The app doesn't work. I called customer service and was told to reset my password even after I told the representative that the password reset didn't work. Poor customer service and a horrible app. I just need to access my account and close it out!

I really like your app, but it would be really helpful if there was a free form field for customizations like what coffee you would like in your drink for example blond roast or pike place etc. It is a waste when I have to request a remake of my Cafe Misto that is made with coffee vs espresso. Although I like this app a lot, I have experienced difficulties with the rewards program. For instance, the last stars challenge I participated in did not recognize one of my purchases and did not recognize the completion. Starbucks rewards was very amicable in remedying this problem. Thank-you.

Love that they have lattes at 5am, and the only place in town that serves coffee that early. Thank you Starbucks! The app makes getting coffee way more convenient too:) just a click or two of the buttons and just like magic you have your favorite drink waiting for you....

I just installed it because of a rewards offer and it is so easy and fast to use. I love it!! Overall still loving the app, it's fast and easy to use. You just have to remember to save your preferences on your drinks!
